children: Leader’s Advantage Acquisition completed a $150 million SPAC IPO of 15,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit and put $151,125,000 of proceeds into a U.S.-based trust. To support the offering and post-IPO operations, the company executed an underwriting pact with Clear Street and D. Boral Capital, finalized warrant and trust agreements with Odyssey Transfer & Trust, and granted registration rights to its sponsor and the underwriters. Concurrently, it sold $1.93 million of private placement shares to the underwriters and $3.5 million of private placement warrants to the sponsor, and entered insider and administrative services agreements. The package establishes liquidity safeguards, aligns incentives, and funds the search for a business combination.
